name: Cobisa (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Cobisa (a saltire with stars on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Cobisa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
